mapper.select: SELECT c.member_id, c.sku, p.product_name, p.price, c.qty, c.added_at FROM CART_ITEMS c JOIN PRODUCTS p ON c.sku = p.sku WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.added_at, c.sku
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS (member_id, sku, qty, added_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sku}, #{qty}, NOW())
INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS (member_id, sku, qty, added_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sku}, #{qty}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE qty = qty + VALUES(qty)
mapper.select: SELECT c.member_id, c.sku, c.qty, c.added_at FROM CART_ITEMS c WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.added_at, c.sku FOR UPDATE
